messages:
Priya Shah: opened a small PR to tighten audit webhook examples and add an export + redaction CLI. Need legal wording check before merge. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/912
Omar Diaz: can you paste the minimal example payload you plan to use? I want to ensure no accidental PII.
Priya Shah: example in PR:
```json
{
  \"event\": \"auth.success\",
  \"tenant_id\": \"t-555\",
  \"ts\": \"2026-04-02T11:00:00Z\",
  \"actor\": { \"type\": \"user\", \"pid\": \"pid-abc123\" },
  \"meta\": { \"pseudonym_id\": \"usr-xxxx\", \"ip\": \"[redacted]\" }
}
```
Elena Kaur: looks good. please explicitly call out that raw email/phone should never be sent.
Samir Patel: I'll add small SDK migration snippets for JS/Python and a compatibility line: `const evt = payload.event || payload.audit_event;`
Legal - Compliance: Suggested retention sentence: "Default retention for audit records is 90 days (configurable by contract). Legal holds will preserve records beyond the TTL until released." Also request linking to evidence playbook + export API docs.
Priya Shah: added that sentence and a short FAQ: "What if my integration sends PII? -> Remove raw PII and use pseudonym IDs; contact support for migration assistance."
Omar Diaz: adding curl export example with redact flag to PR:
```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.example/v1/audit/export" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"since":"2026-01-01","redact_keys":["email","phone","ip"],"format":"jsonl"}' \
  -o audit-export.json
```
Docs will show sample lines with "ip":"[redacted]".
Docs Bot: linkcheck: evidence-playbook link currently 404 on staging.
Priya Shah: I'll fix the link target and push an amend. Tagging @Legal - Compliance for final wording. Once green, I'll merge and run linkcheck.
Legal - Compliance: approve pending link fix and export sample showing redaction.
Samir Patel: also recommend emitting `X-Deprecation-Warning` header when legacy key `audit_event` is used for 60 days.
Priya Shah: noted, will add deprecation note and changelog entry. Thanks everyone!
